sentences: A disjunctive normal form represents a Boolean function as an OR of conjunctions.
The question asks for deterministic relative approximation of the number of satisfying assignments.
Overlapping terms make naive addition overcount, while a small satisfying fraction makes additive approximation insufficient.
A fully specified solution would remove randomness from a basic approximate counting task closely connected with pseudorandomness.
